social_world.value: Publishing industry hierarchy: series editor (Otto Penzler) holds gatekeeping power over authors; literary periodicals vs. mainstream publishers; authors who refuse inclusion (Doctorow, Boyle) assert status autonomy against the anthology's authority structure.
social_world.quote: T. Coraghessan Boyle said he wasn't a mystery writer and didn't want to be identified as one

media_and_audience.value: The anthology itself functions as a packaging and legitimising mechanism for crime fiction; story titles deliberately obscure genre identity, meaning public/reader perception cannot reliably identify a crime story from its title alone.
media_and_audience.quote: check the table of contents for 'Thug: Signification and the (De) Construction of Self' and decide if it leaps out at you as a crime story
